context:
Goal: ship iOS builds to TestFlight without the Mac, in one shape for home, degen and mailaudit.
Problem (risk): today the App Store Connect key lives only on the Mac, so every ship needs the Mac. Shipping from GitHub Actions puts a copy of that key in GitHub, which needs your word.
Based on (read): decision ios-ship-is-one-shared-tool says the .p8 key lives only on the Mac and bin/ios-ship ships from there.
Based on (read): the mailaudit, home and degen coordinators agreed one shared reusable macOS workflow on 2026-11-08; mailaudit is public (macOS minutes free), home and degen are private (minutes bill after the free credit).
Departs from: ios-ship-is-one-shared-tool (key only on the Mac, ship from the Mac) — the key also lives as a secret of a GitHub environment `testflight`, and a separate workflow uploads from main.
Meanwhile: nothing ships from Actions; each repo keeps shipping from the Mac.

options.gain: Builds ship with the Mac off; one shape in three repos; each upload waits for your approval.
options.how: One claude-settings record plus the shared reusable workflow: (1) the .p8 and its ids live only as secrets of a GitHub environment `testflight` that needs your approval and deploys only from main; (2) the upload is its own workflow, on push to main or manual dispatch, never on pull_request or pull_request_target; (3) test jobs run on plain pull_request with no secrets; (4) no session writes, prints or logs a key value, and you add the secret on GitHub's settings page; (5) a private repo states its macOS minute cost in the workflow's record. Each repo keeps its own ruling on where builds ship.
options.label: Adopt the shared rule
options.lose: The key has a second home on GitHub; private repos pay macOS minutes after the free credit; you add the secret by hand in each repo.

options.gain: The key stays on one machine.
options.how: No change: bin/ios-ship on the Mac stays the one way to ship.
options.label: Keep shipping from the Mac only
options.lose: Every TestFlight build needs the Mac on and a session there.

reply: Closed as a, 19:53 CST Nov 8, on your word via the home cloud coordinator (ask ask-mw8lt9pjm7, 19:49 CST): builds ship from GitHub Actions, with the key in repo secrets ASC_KEY_P8, ASC_KEY_ID and ASC_ISSUER_ID, already set in home, degen and mailaudit. Home builds the workflow first; claude-settings lifts it into the shared rule once it proves out (step testflight-from-actions). Not ruled: the environment-approval detail in point 1, which home's version settles.
title: Ship iOS builds to TestFlight from GitHub Actions, with the App Store key held as a protected GitHub secret?
